name: Reconnaissance
description: Threat actor is trying to gather information they can use to plan future operations.

name: Resource Development
description: Threat actor is trying to establish resources they can use to support operations.

name: Initial Access
description: Threat actor is trying to get point of presence/command execution on the spacecraft or hosted payload.

name: Execution
description: Threat actor is trying to execute malicious code on the spacecraft.

name: Persistence
description: Threat actor is trying to maintain their foothold/access to command/execute code on the spacecraft.

name: Defense Evasion
description: Threat actor is trying to avoid being detected.

name: Lateral Movement
description: Threat actor is trying to move through/across sub-systems and/or payloads of the spacecraft.

name: Exfiltration
description: Threat actor is trying to steal information.

name: Impact
description: Adversary activity that directly produces or sustains an effect against the affected system, payload, subsystem, or mission function.
